lessons.outcome: I can interpret a literary subject placed after the verb.

objectives.label: Recognize verb–subject order as a way of introducing a new actor in a narrative scene.

units.title: Variation and register
units.description: Recognize spoken constructions and choose edited alternatives.

lessons.title: Spoken dislocation in context
lessons.outcome: I can identify a spoken topic structure and recast it for a formal text.

objectives.label: Recognize clitic resumption as common in conversation; choose a neutral order for formal editing when needed.

lessons.title: Match request to audience
lessons.outcome: I can rewrite a direct request for a formal recipient while preserving the request.

objectives.label: Use a courteous conditional and a clear request complement in formal correspondence.

units.title: Edit a complex text
units.description: Correct logical links, compress repetition and keep parallel structures.

lessons.title: Repair a false logical link
lessons.outcome: I can replace a connector that misstates the relation between claims.

objectives.label: Choose a connector from the actual logic, not from surface punctuation.

lessons.title: Compress without hiding an agent
lessons.outcome: I can condense a clause while keeping who did what clear.

objectives.label: Use nominalization with a named agent when it is needed for meaning.

lessons.title: Parallel clauses in edited prose
lessons.outcome: I can repair an uneven pair of coordinated complements.

objectives.label: Give coordinated items the same grammatical form when they play the same role.

units.title: Interpret and produce
units.description: Apply grammar choices across short authentic-style situations.

lessons.title: Read stance across two sentences
lessons.outcome: I can identify what is asserted and what remains a possibility.

objectives.label: Track both source marking and grammatical mood across a short report.

lessons.title: Choose a precise final wording
lessons.outcome: I can produce a concise, logically precise sentence for a specified audience.

objectives.label: Combine condition, consequence and register in a single short rewrite.

lessons.title: Chi sono
lessons.outcome: Say who you are with essere and avere: name, city, nationality, age and job.

lessons.title: Cosa faccio
lessons.outcome: Say what you do every day with regular -are, -ere and -ire verbs.

lessons.title: Mi piace
lessons.outcome: Say what you like and do not like with mi piace and mi piacciono.

lessons.title: Dove e quando
lessons.outcome: Add where and when to a sentence: a casa, al bar, in ufficio, la mattina, stasera, il lunedì.

lessons.title: Domande
lessons.outcome: Ask yes/no questions and dove, quando, chi and che cosa questions, and give short answers.

lessons.title: Come stai?
lessons.outcome: Hold your first full conversation: greet, say how you are, and make a plan.

lessons.title: Ieri ho…
lessons.outcome: Say what you did with avere and a past participle.

lessons.title: Sono andato
lessons.outcome: Say where you went with essere and a participle that agrees with you.

lessons.title: Quando?
lessons.outcome: Say when something happened with ieri, la settimana scorsa, due giorni fa.

lessons.title: Era così
lessons.outcome: Set the scene in the past with the imperfetto, then report one event.

lessons.title: Raccontami
lessons.outcome: Tell what happened yesterday in a conversation, mixing events and background.

lessons.title: Domani
lessons.outcome: Say what you will do tomorrow, next week and next year with the futuro semplice.

lessons.title: Progetti
lessons.outcome: Talk about plans with volere, dovere and potere plus an infinitive, with andare a, and with the present used for a fixed plan.

lessons.title: Se…
lessons.outcome: Link a condition in the present to a result in the present or the future with se.

lessons.title: Che farai?
lessons.outcome: Ask and answer about weekend plans, mixing the future, modal verbs and se.

lessons.title: Lo conosco
lessons.outcome: Replace a known person or thing with lo, la, li, le, and use mi, ti, ci, vi inside the sentence.

lessons.title: Chi, che cosa, perché
lessons.outcome: Ask with chi, che cosa, dove, quando, come, quanto and perché, and answer a perché question with perché.

lessons.title: Quindi, allora, però
lessons.outcome: Join two ideas with quindi, allora, però, invece, anche, infatti, perché and poiché.

lessons.title: La mia giornata
lessons.outcome: Tell your daily routine with reflexive verbs in the present, and say when you got up with the passato prossimo.

lessons.title: Più o meno
lessons.outcome: Compare people and things with più … di, meno … di, come and il più …, with the adjective agreeing.

lessons.title: Una vera chiacchierata
lessons.outcome: Hold a longer conversation: replace with a pronoun, ask, join ideas, tell your day and compare.
